headline: China’s 2030 national informatization plan sets AI research and intelligent-internet priorities
summary: On 23 October 2026, China’s Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued its Fifteenth Five-Year National Informatization Plan. The Cyberspace Administration of China’s official release and Q&A describe a national 2030 programme with 12 indicators, 10 task areas and seven action columns, including intelligent-internet infrastructure, AI-enabled research and development, foundation-model and collective-intelligence research, industrial application, AI skills and safety governance. These are plan objectives and government statements; the linked full plan PDF was inaccessible during this review, and implementation, appropriations, infrastructure delivery and measured outcomes were not established.
